title: Haye Chup Kar Ke Tur Paya
body:
Sir-o-Nageaan Vekh Ke Phupiyaan Nu Khaware Ki Sochea
Edi Vad Gaye, Haye Edi Vad Gaye, Hor Beemari
<<DIVIDER>>
Enj Lang Gaya Pyu Di Laash Kolo, Jiven Kuj Nai Es Da Lagda
Bewarsaan Waang Hussain Peya, Jerda Waaris Haye Do Jag Da
Sang Baal Yateem Te Mastooraan, Pairaan Vich Berdiyaan
Bani Abid, Haye Bani Abid Di Laachari
<<DIVIDER>>
Jerdi Ghar Vich Tur Di Thak Jaave, Kivein Shaam De Safar Nibhaa Gaye
Shabeer Ne Deen Bachaya Eh, Shabeer Nu Bhain Bacha Gayee
Hoi Dafan Begaanea Watanaa Te, Chad Apne Des Nu
Haye Zainab, Haye Zainab, Dardaan Mari
<<DIVIDER>>
Masoom Sakina Lab Di Nai, Zara Abid Rok Muhaaraan
Shabeer Di Bachrdi Vichar Gayi, Ro Aakhan Parde Daaraan
Nai Waqif Shaam De Raavan Te, Mar Jave Na Kithe
Teri Dukheya, Haye Teri Dukheya, Bhain Vachaari
